name: RSS
description: Trigger workflows from new items in RSS, Atom and JSON Feed feeds, and read feeds or find the feeds a web page declares from a step.

triggers.label: New item
triggers.description: An item appears in any of the connection's feeds. The first poll of a feed fires only for items inside the look-back, an item with no date fires once, and an item dated before the newest one already seen never fires.

env.name: RSS_FEEDS
env.description: Feed addresses, one per line or comma separated. The new-item trigger polls them, and Read feeds uses them when it is given none.
env.builderHint: RSS, Atom or JSON Feed addresses rather than the site's page; Find feeds turns a page into its feed addresses. https:// is assumed when there is no scheme.

env.name: RSS_LOOKBACK_HOURS
env.description: How far back the first poll of a feed reaches, a whole number of hours from 1 to 8760, so a new connection does not fire for the whole backlog.
env.builderHint: Only the first poll of each feed reads it; later polls fire on whatever is newer than the last one.

env.name: RSS_USER_AGENT
env.description: Sent with every request; some hosts refuse requests without one.
env.builderHint: Leave the default unless a host asks for a contact address in it.

actions.label: Read a feed
actions.description: The newest items of one RSS, Atom or JSON Feed feed, up to 100, newest first with dateless items last.

inputs.label: Feed URL
inputs.description: The feed's address; https:// is assumed when there is no scheme.
inputs.builderHint: A feed, not a web page; run Find feeds on a page to get its feed.

inputs.label: Items
inputs.description: How many of the newest items, a whole number from 1 to 100; 20 when empty.

inputs.label: Within hours
inputs.description: Only items published within this many hours; items with no date are left out when set.
inputs.builderHint: Match it to how often the workflow runs, such as 24 for a daily digest.

outputs.description: The feed as { title, url, siteUrl, format }, format one of rss2, rss1, atom, json
Items as { id, title, url, author, publishedAt, updatedAt, summary, html, categories, feedTitle, feedUrl }
How many items came back, in `items`

actions.label: Read feeds
actions.description: Items from several feeds at once, filtered by age and keywords, one copy per address, newest first. A feed that fails is listed with its reason and never loses the others' items.

inputs.label: Feed URLs
inputs.description: Feed addresses, one per line or comma separated; the connection's feeds when empty.
inputs.builderHint: Leave it empty to read the feeds the connection already polls.

inputs.label: Within hours
inputs.description: Only items published within this many hours; items with no date are left out when set.
inputs.builderHint: Match it to how often the workflow runs, such as 24 for a daily digest.

inputs.label: Items per feed
inputs.description: The newest items kept from each feed, a whole number from 1 to 100; 20 when empty.

inputs.label: Keywords
inputs.description: Comma separated; an item passes when any one matches its title or summary as a whole word or phrase, ignoring case. Empty keeps everything.
inputs.builderHint: Whole words only: "AI" matches "AI agents" but not "said".

inputs.label: Feeds that must answer
inputs.description: The action fails, naming every failed feed, when fewer feeds than this answer; 1 when empty.
inputs.builderHint: Set it to the number of feeds when every one of them has to be read.

outputs.description: Items as { id, title, url, author, publishedAt, updatedAt, summary, html, categories, feedTitle, feedUrl }
How many items came back, in `items`
The feeds that did not answer, as [{ url, error }]

actions.label: Save feeds to a file
actions.description: Read feeds exactly as Read feeds does, then write the items to a JSON file instead of returning them, so a large read never has to pass through a template.

inputs.label: File
inputs.description: Where to write, as an absolute path or one starting with ~/; its folder is created when missing.
inputs.builderHint: For example ~/digests/items.json; a relative path is refused, and an existing file is replaced.

inputs.label: Feed URLs
inputs.description: Feed addresses, one per line or comma separated; the connection's feeds when empty.
inputs.builderHint: Leave it empty to read the feeds the connection already polls.

inputs.label: Within hours
inputs.description: Only items published within this many hours; items with no date are left out when set.
inputs.builderHint: Match it to how often the workflow runs, such as 24 for a daily digest.

inputs.label: Items per feed

inputs.label: Keywords
inputs.description: Comma separated; an item passes when any one matches its title or summary as a whole word or phrase, ignoring case. Empty keeps everything.
inputs.builderHint: Whole words only: "AI" matches "AI agents" but not "said".

actions.label: Find feeds
actions.description: The RSS, Atom and JSON Feed feeds a web page declares in its link rel="alternate" tags, as absolute addresses with their titles; the address itself when it already is a feed.

inputs.label: Page URL
inputs.description: A web page's address, or a feed's; https:// is assumed when there is no scheme.
inputs.builderHint: A site's home page usually declares its feeds; a page that declares none returns an empty list.

outputs.description: The feeds found, as [{ url, title, type, format }]
Whether the address given is itself a feed
